reason: The close verdict holds, but the stated bound is wrong and needs rewording. VERIFIED: x138 cell 3 hard-sets BIOHUB_SECONDARY_EDGE_WEIGHT '0.15' (l.653), SECONDARY_LINK_MODE 'low_margin_consensus' (l.660) and SECONDARY_LOW_MARGIN_MAX '0.35' (l.662) after the cell-0 overrides (experiments/exp56_x138_verbatim/exp56-x138-verbatim.ipynb), so --set is a silent no-op (I-309). The same_parent veto is not a knob at all: it lives in the cell-4 patch-3 source, so dropping it is a code change. CORRECTIONS: (1) +0.0011 is not a ceiling for an edge gate. It is the combo-oracle L_remove_attach_noswap arm (25 removals + end->free-start attaches; combo_oracle/m_joint_oracle.json). A change to the edge logits can also move a link from w->v to u->v (swap type), and the full no-node relink oracle, swaps included, is +0.0073 lab (+0.0062 of it from 129 swaps). It can also add or remove ILP forks, which no oracle bounds. The swap share was judged not actionable (GT identity jump, or a missing/offset detection matched loosely; v_joint_oracle_0/1), so the honest wording is: +0.0011 is the actionable linking ceiling, +0.0073 is the no-node ceiling including swaps, and the fork side is unbounded. (2) '<= ~+0.0002 public' applies the 1/6 transfer to an oracle, which v_joint_oracle_1 point 3 calls a category error; drop it. The verdict still holds for other reasons. There is no CPU lab (edge_cache edge arrays are empty), and a GPU arm costs ~2 x 1.95 h against R8 at 27 Sep 12:00Z. Knob sign is unknown in both directions. imissher's paired LB tests of x138's neighbouring knobs (det 0.960/0.970, secondary weight 0.65) were all lower, so the knobs sit near a local optimum. The ladder takes informed combos from POSITIVE singles only, so an unlabbed rung would be public knob-picking on a one-embryo 29% LB. Both finals share the fusion, so it cannot separate #37 from #38.
